scope: All ten current full-time first-year UG degrees, government directory college2005, printed129/PDF170. No general foreign route inferred.

eligibleAudiences: Eligible Tamil Nadu native OCI/PIO applicants
Eligible Sri Lankan Tamil refugees educated in Tamil Nadu
restrictions: This offering covers the TNEA first-year route, not unrestricted international admission.

Tamil Nadu candidates who completed Classes 8–12 in Tamil Nadu do not need a nativity certificate. Tamil Nadu natives who studied any of those classes outside the state need the prescribed electronic nativity certificate.
Children of Central Government employees serving continuously in Tamil Nadu for five years may apply with employer evidence; a guardian qualifies only when both parents are deceased.
Children of permanent employees of public-sector or government-recognised institutions serving continuously in Tamil Nadu for five years may apply with employer and employment evidence.
Children of All India Service officers of the Tamil Nadu cadre may apply with the required parental self-declaration. Other-state applicants who completed Classes 8–12 in Tamil Nadu may also apply.
The parental-service and other-state schooling categories compete in Open Competition, not Tamil Nadu communal reservation.
Tamil Nadu native OCI/PIO cardholders may compete in Open Category; the exception excludes those born abroad after 4 March 2021.
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees educated in Tamil Nadu may compete in Open Competition with the prescribed refugee documentation.
Communal reservation requires Tamil Nadu nativity and a valid Tamil Nadu community certificate; other eligible categories compete in Open Competition.
audience.notes: This is the verified counselling audience only. No general foreign-national admission pathway is represented.

qualifications.intro: Entry to B.E. Civil Engineering follows the TNEA first-year academic or specified vocational qualification routes, together with the applicable nationality and Tamil Nadu connection rules.
items: Pass HSC academic +1 and +2 or an accepted equivalent; the minimum +2 Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry average is 45% for General and 40% for BC/BCM, MBC/DNC and SC/SCA/ST.
An approved HSC vocational route is also available, using a related Mathematics, Physics or Chemistry subject plus vocational theory and practical marks at the same category thresholds.
TNEA accepts the specified mechanical, electrical, electronics, civil, automobile and textile vocational groups; eligibility depends on the actual qualifying subject combination.
Fulfil TNEA nationality, nativity or schooling rules. Tamil Nadu communal reservation is separate from Open Competition eligibility.
Selection uses the TNEA merit and counselling process; minimum qualifying marks do not assure a seat in this branch.

application: Applicable nativity certificate or parent-employer documentation
Tamil Nadu community certificate for a claimed reserved category
First-graduate certificate and joint declaration, when applicable
Applicable refugee, disability, sports or ex-serviceman supporting certificates
OCI/PIO card and Tamil Nadu nativity evidence, when that exception is claimed
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees: Headquarters Tahsildar identification certificate.
Refugee applicants not registered in a camp additionally need original passport, visa and police-station registration letter.
